FN-V7FI2PL-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 437
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 437 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Conservation
and Natural Resources (DCNR) by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to establish a
shark alert system for beaches and shorelines in Baldwin and Mobile County as provided by this
bill. This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of: (1) DCNR to adopt rules and
advertise the system; and (2) the Alabama Emergency Management Agency, Alabama State Law
Enforcement Agency, the Alabama Department of Public Health, the Offices of Sheriff of
Baldwin and Mobile Counties, local municipalities and law enforcement agencies, and other
state departments and agencies to cooperate with DCNR to implement the system.
